inventive_nucleus: A tapered lead fixation point reduces stress concentration at the lead fixation point.
causal_chain: Lead fracture occurs due to mechanical stress
Mechanical stress is concentrated at the lead fixation point
The tapered lead fixation point reduces stress concentration
Reduced stress concentration decreases likelihood of lead fracture
Decreased likelihood of lead fracture improves DBS system reliability
Improved DBS system reliability enhances patient outcomes

predictions.conditions: Tapered lead fixation point used in 80% of DBS implantations over 2 years
predictions.falsifier: No significant decrease in lead breakage rate observed after 2 years of tapered lead fixation point use in at least 500 DBS implantations

falsification_tests: No significant decrease in lead breakage rate observed after 2 years of tapered lead fixation point use in at least 500 DBS implantations

experiment_plan.objective: To investigate the effect of a tapered lead fixation point on stress concentration at the lead fixation point in DBS systems
controls: Current DBS systems with standard lead fixation points
Different DBS systems with varying lead fixation points
experiment_plan.baseline: Current DBS systems with standard lead fixation points
procedure: Randomly assign 800 patients to the tapered lead fixation point group and 200 patients to the standard lead fixation point group
Monitor lead breakage rate over 2 years
Compare lead breakage rates between the two groups
experiment_plan.expected_result: A 30% decrease in lead breakage rate in the tapered lead fixation point group compared to the standard lead fixation point group
experiment_plan.falsification_condition: No significant decrease in lead breakage rate observed after 2 years of tapered lead fixation point use in at least 500 DBS implantations
experiment_plan.safety_constraints: Ensure that the tapered lead fixation point does not cause any adverse effects on the patient's health
experiment_plan.information_gain: Understanding the effect of tapered lead fixation point on stress concentration at the lead fixation point in DBS systems, which can lead to improved DBS system design and reduced lead breakage rates

commercial.economic_problem: Reduced device failure rates and associated costs
commercial.manufacturing_relevance: High, as it requires precision manufacturing of implantable devices
commercial.regulatory_path_hypothesis: 510(k) clearance from the FDA, with potential for PMA approval for more complex applications
commercial.commercial_classification: A|High commercial potential due to the significant improvement in DBS system reliability and the potential for cost savings
